summary: The audit checks the 135 graduate units (your DBIO 399 or GENE 399 research units count toward them) and DBIO 210 and DBIO 215. You check by hand the other three required courses (an advanced graduate course in genetics or genomics, one in cell biology or biochemistry, and one in quantitative or computational biology), seminar and journal club attendance, the qualifying exam, the University Oral Examination and the dissertation.

EB5a8O4K.why: "Students can adjust the units of their Graduate Research course (DBIO 399 or GENE 399) to 10 units per quarter (before reaching TGR) or 3 units per quarter (after advancing to TGR) to reach 135 units." The 135 units are the Bulletin's program minimum, counted over the graduate career, not 135 units of research.

QFc9Vg99.why: "Students are expected to attend Developmental Biology seminars and journal clubs."

7ETJIIrP.why: "Completion of a qualifying examination is required for admission to PhD candidacy. The examination consists of an off-topic proposal on a subject different from the dissertation research."

1boyGF1p.why: "The student must pass the University Oral Examination, taken only after substantially completing their research." A requirement, not an overview.

do4y828c.why: "The final requirements of the program include the presentation of a PhD dissertation as the result of independent investigation". A requirement, not an overview.
